author_boundary: Independent reviewer of control_protection; did not author the helper, native provider or lifecycle core. Wrote only this report and a separate synthetic host fixture under runs/.

findings.fact: Pure bounded policy and disjoint input/workspace/output checks precede internal pin. Native entry takes no raw setup, address, read callbacks or detached receipt. Native pin latches its attempt before calling frozen provider, including failure/nonreturn; invalid pure preflight does not consume it.

Read callbacks/context are copied before the initial getter; both mapping passes use captured lookup and stable checks invoke captured observe. Boot composition copies the entire callback table before pin and invokes captured configure only after original table equality check. Native wrapper builds its own const local table. A changed original table cannot redirect the second pass or configure. Independent mutation cases exercised getter/lookup/pin changes and confirmed no evil callback ran or output changed. Accessible stable callback/context storage and serialization remain trusted preconditions.

Complete object byte aliases are refused before preflight writes; after typed getter identifies the mutex, workspace/output are checked against both actual control byte spans before scratch memset. Source/profile, immutable policy/setup and callback identity are checked after the initial getter. Native getter receives only the internally held setup identity.

Exact pinned private types and getter signatures require mutex16/alignment8, 32-bit ppnum and 64-bit addr64. Runtime shift14 and both16KiB page forms must agree. Checked full control spans enumerate at most8 distinct CPU pages before any lookup. Each nonzero ppnum is at most0x3fffff and is widened before shift14; the full PA page stays within36bits. No DART TTBR shift or VA arithmetic conversion is used.

Each full derived PA page must fit in one original RAM interval and avoid every original reservation. Adjacent sub-RAM ranges cannot jointly authorize a page. Final RAM preserves all original interval boundaries; only exact CPU/PA and forbidden unions merge overlapping/adjacent extents. Holes remain holes, PA aliases are deduplicated in protection only, original reservations survive, and capacity overflow refuses instead of widening/truncating.

Internal expected/candidate consistency binds setup generation/identity, source/type hashes, every page/ppnum/PA, canonical base/final policy and protection/provenance. Configure receives that same derived candidate once. Only known configure success plus post-call consistency commits configured=1 to public output. Failures leave public output unchanged; scratch can change. A post-configure refusal does not roll back the retained native controls or authorize retry.

Revision002 only extracts callback-free receipt assembly and uses already captured workspace.original_setup/source instead of equivalent stable live locals. All original capture/query/stability guards remain before assembly. Only README and this C file differ from archived001; API/native adapter/test files unchanged. Original target stage1040/1024 failure is retained, not regraded.

existing_frozen_suite.scope: Host execution of real algorithm and native adapter with explicit original stand-ins; no kernel translation/pin/configure was called.

cases_detail: 512 geometry/mapping cases with an independent page-membership oracle for every final protected/reserved page, holes and original reservation preservation
8 original callback-table mutation/configure-failure/post-configure-mutation cases; output unchanged and zero redirected callback calls

independent_scenarios.scope: Synthetic metadata and instrumented callbacks only; all fixture addresses are invented and no physical memory was queried.

actual_target_build_cross_binding.reported_scope: Actual real-framework ARM64 objects at O0/O2 plus mixed relocatable link; source review did not rerun a compiler or independently re-audit every object/import. Both Unsupported pmap imports remain explicit. Per-function frame guard is not a complete call-chain stack bound.

limitations: Trusted accessible immutable pointers, single-threaded serialized boot sequencing and resident code/control lifetime are required; this helper is not a security boundary against privileged callers.

Low-level injected derive/boot APIs and bcp_check_workspace are trusted/internal interfaces. A detached consistent receipt or nonzero provenance is not authentication. Frozen raw native configure remains a privileged bypass outside this call-path contract.
Two equal mappings show sample consistency only; no future no-remap guarantee, page pinning or independent RAM/protection completeness attestation follows.
Coverage is typed anchor and underlying16-byte mutex plus intersecting full pages, not allocator/slab/turnstile/global metadata.
Caller output commit is serialized copying, not atomic multiword publication. Failed/uncertain native operations retain controls and require stopping; there is no rollback/retry/free/unload path.

No native translation/configuration/allocation, backing experiment, provider exposure join, module/KC/image/packet/deployment, MMIO/DART/IRQ/firmware/ACTIVE or Wi-Fi operation was admitted or executed.
Future module integration must declare com.apple.kpi.unsupported for kernel_pmap/pmap_find_phys and separately establish actual protected platform policy and boot-lifetime ownership.
